claims.title: Six fresh starts and warm completions retain scoped science without establishing a superior research method

quoted_fields.interface: Exact launch inputs, frozen stage1/stage2 outputs and completed masked-label reviews. Opportunity selection was part of treatment; one broad mission family, not six independently matched questions. Requested inherited settings were not immutable served-model/compute receipts.
quoted_fields.failure: Small observational study; unequal opportunities and unmeasured compute preclude a causal package ranking. Forty/thirty-minute allowances are not measured inference, tokens or compute. Masking was imperfect. Interruptions resumed the same context without reroll. Trial numerical artifacts are synthetic. The post-outcome two known-item retrieval queries are exposed diagnostics, not held out or a general search ranking. No eighteen-trial, Pro-versus-ExtraHigh, worker-allocation or Dots conclusion.

claims.title: Choose between reciprocal-tree capacity cost and an ideal conductance-switch timing frontier

quoted_fields.interface: Linear fixed reciprocal tree, one initially excited source, fixed-temperature bath and positive capacities/conductances for the first theorem. The second requires one constant-capacity reservoir, local memoryless G(T), finite contrast, no subsequent input and all leakage counted.
quoted_fields.failure: Tree theorem does not cover loops, narrow-window concentration, nonlinear/scheduled switches or multiple excited nodes. RMS waveform width differs from timing jitter. Thermal ladder optimization maps to established OU optimal design. The continuum realization requires actual geometric regime: fixed capacity/material/delay do not independently make the slenderness parameter small. Physical switch examples do not supply the ideal local G(T); two-temperature closure/ON regimes cannot be blended. QP trajectory did not reproduce identically, although saved feasible objectives were checked. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

claims.title: Separate useful switched diffusion routing from cooling gain and perfect isolation

quoted_fields.interface: Finite reciprocal bounded nonnegative periodic conductances, constant storage and unique stable periodic solution. Static comparison admits general SPD storage; positive-sign/support theorem additionally requires diagonal positive capacities. All terminal offsets constant, full repeated cycle, no internal sources/advection.
quoted_fields.failure: A path through another clamped terminal is not a transmitting path. General SPD storage cannot inherit compartment positivity. The comparator requires feasible mean contacts; no assertion for every nonconvex actuator budget or every individual current at distinct temperatures. Finite isolation is possible; Float64 zero is not exact zero. At z800 reverse1.5282810767e-351 survives while the saved Float64 coefficient underflows. No universal approximate-router no-go. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.

claims.title: Distinguish finite-time tolerance evidence from proof of permanent material rigidity

quoted_fields.interface: Initially equilibrated linear passive positive relaxation measure, g>=0, g+mass(mu)=A, calibrated common additive Gaussian noise sigma and bounded causal strain. Binary step dominance requires nonnegative contrast kernel; passivity alone is insufficient. Rate-floor minimax test requires an independently known positive lower relaxation rate.
quoted_fields.failure: A finite fitted spectrum does not acquire a rate floor. Tolerance upper bound cannot certify exact g=0 or positive permanent rigidity. Pointwise convergence is consistent with uniform impossibility; the slow alternative in a lower-bound proof can depend on horizon. Half-normal mixture statistics are established Howard et al. machinery. All-window ordinary comparator won30/32 final comparisons, with two uninformative ties; empirical coverage fractions are not universal guarantees. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.
